text: [312] 41 evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā 1 rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate . atha kho āyasmā sārīputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasa aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ disvā bhikkhū āmantesi passatha no āvuso tumeha amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhanti evamāvusoti . ākaṅkhamāno āvuso bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ paṭhavītevava adhimucceyya taṃ kissa hetu atthi #1 ma. yu. āyasmā sārīputato . āvuso amusmiṃ dārukkhandhe paṭhavīdhātu yaṃ nissāya bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ paṭhavītevava adhimucceyya . ākaṅkhamāno āvuso bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ āpotevava adhimucceyya .pe. tejotevava adhimucceyya vāyotevava adhimucceyya subhantevava adhimucceyya asubhantevava adhimucceyya taṃ kissa hetu atthi āvuso amusmiṃ dārukkhandhe asubhadhātu yaṃ nissāya bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto amuṃ dārukkhandhaṃ asubhantevava adhimucceyyāti .
